name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.ui.photo.TransferHelperActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK starts this Activity when it opens the camera or image picker, or shows an Android permission prompt. These actions are used by its photo capture, image selection, and cropping features.
disableEffect: Photo capture, image selection, and Yunxin permission requests that use this Activity will not complete.
